HAPPY_WAKEY_SIDECAR_BIND.description: Loopback HTTP listener for inherited health, readiness, and metrics probes.

HAPPY_WAKEY_SIDECAR_PRODUCT_KIND.description: Product process next to this sidecar: api or web.

HAPPY_WAKEY_SIDECAR_PRODUCT_PROBE_URL.description: Credential-free loopback HTTP health endpoint for the adjacent product process.

HAPPY_WAKEY_SHARED_AUTH_BASE_URL.description: Shared Auth authority URL; no credential is accepted by this sidecar.

HAPPY_WAKEY_OPTO_SYNC_BASE_URL.description: Opto Sync authority URL; no write token is accepted by this sidecar.

HAPPY_WAKEY_SIDECAR_SUCCESS_THRESHOLD.description: Consecutive successful probes required to enter Ready.

HAPPY_WAKEY_SIDECAR_FAILURE_THRESHOLD.description: Consecutive failed probes required to enter Degraded.
